name: Mashou Hime Tiruana Haramase Saimin ~Ningen o Shiitageru Mazoku no Hime ga Anji Hitotsu de Niku Gangu ni Naru~
original_name: 魔将姫ティルアーナ孕ませ催眠 ～人間を虐げる魔族の姫が暗示一つで肉玩具になる～
source:
The protagonist was treated like a slave in the demon army; now he has attained sorcery. 
Demon Princess Tiruana will pay for her oppressive ways by his mystical hand. 
Once her human garbage, he is now her controller; he deceives, manipulates and enslaves her 
just like she had enslaved him! The second stage of life is different for them both. 

* Hypnotize and impregnate the too-proud bishoujo of the dark world!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE165051.html]DLsite English[/url]]
